text: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1127197' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
